title: calendars MemoryBackend::get_availability: use the -34 BusyStatus/IncludeInAvailability helpers
description: Found in spec-sync batch 1. MemoryBackend::get_availability still returns [] so the reference backend never exercises BusyStatus::for_event and IncludeInAvailability::counts_event (added for JMAP-lehj.2, -34 §2.2). Implement availability in the memory backend with those helpers and test it end to end.
